featureAreas.name: Content and Playback
featureAreas.passWhen: Live TV, VOD, and Series playback paths pass smoke checks with no blocker defects.
featureAreas.failWhen: Any playback entry point fails to start or recover, or a blocker defect remains open.

checks.description: Live channel starts within target startup budget and basic controls work.
VOD starts from catalog and detail page, and seek/resume work.
Episode playback starts from series detail and metadata is correct.
Provider auth succeeds and the live catalog returns non-empty release evidence for the QA account.
Provider-backed focused live/catch-up browser playback smoke passes with redacted evidence.
Catch-up beta evidence proves broken provider archives are not solved with ffmpeg, transcode, remux, generated HLS, or XUI-side media processing.

featureAreas.name: Google Cast
featureAreas.passWhen: Sender, receiver, and remote-control flow work without session reset on renderer switch.
featureAreas.failWhen: Cast session cannot connect reliably, renderer switch breaks playback continuity, or remote controls are inconsistent.

checks.description: Sender discovers receiver and starts remote playback.
Switching local/cast preserves timeline and playback state.

featureAreas.name: AirPlay
featureAreas.passWhen: AirPlay device discovery and route handoff are stable for supported browsers/devices.
featureAreas.failWhen: AirPlay route handoff fails or local/remote state diverges after switching.

checks.description: AirPlay picker can be opened and route can be selected.
Renderer transitions keep expected playback state.

featureAreas.name: PWA Install and Offline
featureAreas.passWhen: Install flow works on supported targets and offline fallback is functional.
featureAreas.failWhen: Install prompts are misleading for unsupported devices, or offline navigation breaks critical flows.

checks.description: Install prompt behavior is correct on Android and iOS home-screen conditions.
Offline fallback page is served for navigation failures.

featureAreas.name: Performance Acceptance
featureAreas.passWhen: Performance benchmarks meet startup and memory thresholds on the 20k channel dataset.
featureAreas.failWhen: Any required performance threshold is violated or benchmark artifacts are missing.

checks.description: p95 time-to-first-channel stays below 3000 ms on benchmark dataset.
Resident memory stays below 200 MB threshold under benchmark load.
300-500 live-user beta capacity plan is approved, including evidence that the production media path does not rely on server-side media processing.

featureAreas.name: Release Quality Gates
featureAreas.passWhen: CI checks are green, smoke/regression matrix is complete, and no blocker defects remain.
featureAreas.failWhen: Any required check is red, matrix execution is incomplete, or unresolved blocker defects exist.

checks.description: Required GitHub checks pass on release candidate branch.
checks.evidence: Latest PR Quality Gate run on the final release-candidate head must be recorded at signoff.

checks.description: Smoke/regression matrix run is complete with signed-off evidence.
No open blocker defects in release scope.

decision.notes: Partial QAF-035 go/no-go artifact. Local provider, no-media, and current PR CI checks have evidence, but final beta signoff remains pending on the readiness blocker triage.
